title: Temporary Visitor
tips:
・Temporary visitor status allows stays of **up to 90 days** in principle

・Used for tourism, business, visiting relatives, and other short-term purposes

・Check the latest application requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)

・Applications can be submitted **from 3 months before** the planned stay

・Required documents may vary depending on the purpose of stay

applicant: Certificate of Purpose for Short-Term Stay
